states: Actual Settings API Access with synthetic inventory and the same fixtures, drafts and scroll anchors before and after: 1440x900 light Chromium 141.0.7390.37, 360x844 dark and 320x720 light touch WebKit 26.0 (Playwright 1.56.1). Inspected fourteen matched pairs.

Pending counts remain Loading and the Restart check fits in the existing row. Name, Generate, scope selection and Custom scopes retain their positions; at 320px the status text wraps to two visible lines. The saved token cards and controls are unchanged.
Read-only pending inventory remains recoverable with Generate and saved-row writes disabled. Unconfirmed create keeps its saved-outcome guidance on failure and cannot be submitted twice.
interactions: Restarted a deliberately pending token GET using Enter on desktop and taps on both phone widths. The superseded GET cancelled; exactly one replacement GET settled the inventory without submitting or repeating a credential change.
A failed replacement after an unconfirmed create keeps Generate blocked until complete readback. The named draft, selected Custom scope and open disclosure survive.
When the focused Restart disappears, desktop focus returns to the inventory. Deliberate input focus is never taken by completion.
